'''Tommy Lodge''' co-hosted the first [[Holotheatre]] Tales episode, ''The Battle of Hoth'', with [[Thomas Santosuosso]] on 23 October 2024, introducing Calgary players [[Clayton Moore]] and [[Panera|Steve]].<ref name="ht-ropEbMxYKXs">[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ropEbMxYKXs&t=136s Star Wars CCG Presents: Holotheatre Tales Episode 1: The Battle of Hoth], Star Wars CCG (23 October 2024). Preserved copy: pending Wayback. Spoken identification 2:16.</ref>
